preregistered.scope: One changed component: historical vs working-tree exporter; shared dependencies held constant.
preregistered.schedule: dev before reserved validation; AB/BA alternates by replicate; no reroll or candidate editing
preregistered.criteria: Complete trials; zero candidate false alarms or unobservable outcomes; stable defect detection strictly increases. All failures and invalid generations retained.

review.note: Requirements, visible fixture transitions and fault controls reviewed before execution. Reserved validation is author-known, not a secret independent test set.

limits: Deterministic button adapter replaces Midscene action planning equally in both arms.
No claim about model quality, native-host execution or broad statistical significance.

summary.scope: Exporter assertion preservation only; not model generation quality, native-host parity, or generalization.

review.note: 按用户明确委托进行代理评审，不代表任职于 Google 或 Apple，也不是独立人工标注。已核对冻结的 8 条用例、24 组注入控制、144 次真实 Chrome 执行及截图；封存哈希与离线重算一致。历史导出器稳定检出 8/16，候选 16/16，保留验证 4/8→8/8；两臂各 24 次正常执行零误报，零不可观测，零不稳定，未丢失既有检出。接受“导出器保留中间断言提高该受控契约集缺陷检出”的有限结论。任务共享两步状态机、验证集由同一代理设计，不能推断生成模型、Midscene 动作规划、真实网站或全部宿主全面提升；本记录不批准对外发布。
